references.text: The Gadites and Reubenites promised earlier in the chapter to go armed ahead of the Israelites, a promise repeated in verse 32.
Moses confirms the conditions under which the tribes may receive land east of the Jordan if they go armed ahead of the Lord.
Moses restates the agreement that the Gadites and Reubenites must cross the Jordan armed to receive their inheritance on the eastern side.
Moses reminds the tribes of the promise to go armed ahead of their brothers into the land of Canaan.
Joshua reminds the Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh to keep their promise to go armed ahead of the other tribes.
The fulfillment of the promise: the Reubenites, Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh went armed ahead of the Israelites across the Jordan.
Joshua sends the tribes back to their inheritance east of the Jordan after the promise has been fulfilled.
